title: Links & sales
subtitle: Clicks on the links in your posts, and the orders and leads they bring.
emptyText: Links in your posts are replaced by short tracked links when they are published. Add the snippet to your website to see sales too.
noLinksText: Publish a post with a link, or create a short link for your bio, a QR code or WhatsApp.
confirmDeleteLink: Delete this short link? It will stop working.
linkReady: Your tracked short link is ready:
label: Name
noConversionsText: Add the snippet to your website, connect your shop with the server key, or add them by hand.
referenceHint: Order or lead number — avoids counting it twice.

products.intro: Your products: announce a new one in one click with your brand design and an AI caption.
products.emptyText: Add your products (name, price, photo, link) and announce new ones automatically.
products.announced: Post created — finish it in the Studio.
products.name: Name
products.caption: Caption
products.modeDraft: Keep as a draft to review
products.modeBest: Schedule at the next best time
products.designHint: A brand template or set (e.g. set:1). Leave empty to post the photo as is.

setup.linksIntro: When a post is published, every link in its text becomes a short link with UTM tags for its network.
setup.enabled: Track the links of my posts
setup.retag: Also re-tag links that already have UTM tags
setup.addRef: Add a click reference (sref) for exact sales attribution
setup.domainHint: Your own domain pointing to this service. Default: {url}
setup.salesIntro: No Odoo needed: three ways to report orders and leads.
setup.step1: Add the snippet to your website
setup.step1Text: In the head section of every page. Then report each order on the thank-you page.
setup.step2Text: An image tag with the order values, for shops that only allow tracking pixels.
setup.step3: Or send them from your server
setup.step3Text: Shops and CRMs can post orders with the server key (trusted, even without a click).
setup.secretOnce: Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
setup.confirmSecret: Replace the server key? The old one stops working.
setup.privacy: Clicks are counted without storing IP addresses; bots and link previews are ignored, and repeated clicks within 24 hours count once.
